einzeiler: Music industry updates covering passing legends, resale costs, and chart toppers.
kurzfassung: This episode covers recent music industry news, including the passing of iconic artists and a study on ticket resale costs. It highlights major management shifts, publishing promotions, and current chart-topping tracks across global platforms. The host also celebrates personal involvement in a number-one album release and shares upcoming community events.
stichpunkte: Tributes to late music and entertainment figures Dolly Parton and Tim Curry
Study reveals ticket resale market costs fans 11 billion dollars annually
Apple Music introduces labels to identify AI-generated tracks
SoundCloud launches a direct sales feature for independent artists
Executive promotions and management signings across major music companies
Ella Langley and Cat's Eye dominate current Billboard and global streaming charts
Host shares personal production credits on the latest number-one physical album
Upcoming community events and listener engagement sessions announced
